descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S11 Scan still works when the panel crosses 250 residents

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Physician with exactly 250 Nursing Home residents: 249 seeded 'QA Bulk' residents (not In Today) plus the fixture resident, which is In Today

When Scan a one-row photo with a new resident (the panel is 250 before the write and 251 after), then scan a second one-row photo with another new resident (the panel is 251 before the write)

Then The UAT sets no panel limit, so both scans add their resident to Today's Visits and All Residents. A refusal of the second scan (panel over 250) is a Fail unless Daniela confirms a limit (Q10)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s11-first contains QA Quill and s11-second contains QA Rowan on Today's Visits (U2); both mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' to prove the tab. replaceTodaysList reads take(251) and refuses a panel of more than 250, so on main the first scan should pass and the second be refused. Whether QA Quill or the fixture resident leaves today is Q1: recorded, not judged

Where it ran: dev; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
